name: ai.privos.demo-hr-miniapp-test
title: HR & HRM
description: HR management app for recruitment, CV screening, lifecycle, payroll, training, documents, and tracked email workflows on PrivOS.

permissions.reason: Identify the approved installation and room so HR workflows load safely.
Read recruitment, employee, training, document, and related HR lists selected for this room.
Create, update, and delete HR records from the dashboard.
List and preview HR documents attached to the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Document previews and the room file list are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Upload HR documents and generated exports to the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Uploads and generated file exports are disabled.

permissions.reason: Use the HR skills enabled in the room sandbox.
Connect the room sandbox to its installation-specific bot identity.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The dashboard cannot connect or rotate the sandbox bot identity.

permissions.reason: Wake the approved room sandbox and display its state.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Sandbox wake and state controls are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Run HR generation workflows in the approved room sandbox.
permissions.degradedBehavior: HR generation workflows cannot be started.

permissions.reason: Read AI chat history created for HR workflows in the approved room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Existing HR AI chat sessions are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Start, send, and stop HR AI chat work in the approved room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: HR AI chat is read-only when read access is granted, or unavailable otherwise.

permissions.reason: Read room-scoped payroll records from this app's App Database.
Create, update, and delete room-scoped payroll records.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Payroll create, update, and delete actions are disabled.

permissions.reason: Read the registered payroll collection schema.
Register or update the payroll collection schema for the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The payroll collection schema cannot be initialized.

dataPolicy.retention: Room HR records and tracked email history are retained until the installation or corresponding Room data is deleted.
